title: Small real-money account risk: alpaca_live notional/exposure cap, reachable-set derived on demand (not a constant), per-account losing-streak floor
note: Opened by BACKLOG-DRAIN-20261112 (one decision per unowned item; operator 2026-11-12 p4) to own 3 pipeline item(s) that had no owning row: BL-20260823-ALPACA-RISK-SIZING-EXCEEDS-ACCOUNT-NOTIONAL-AT-EVERY-FUNDING-LEVEL, BL-20260910-THE-ALPACA-LIVE-REACHABLE-SYMBOL-SET-IS-RECORDED-AS-A-CONSTANT-AND-GDX-HAS-SINCE-FALLEN-OUT-OF-IT, BL-20260911-LOSING-STREAK-SIZE-GATE-IS-A-FLEET-WIDE-ABSOLUTE-SO-IT-UNDER-SERVES-A-SMALL-REAL-MONEY-ACCOUNT. Each item's record carries the evidence. [2026-11-12 lane session_01AFoLuMFGRG8sT3VRva2mo3] TIER-1 BUILT: scripts/ops/account_reachable_set.py (PR #25248, auto-merge armed) derives the reachable set through RiskManager.position_size at live balance + live candles; output is not committed (carries a balance). MEASURED 2026-11-12 ~09:40Z, population 172 (leg,symbol) pairs on the 2-leg roster: 139 size >0, 26 cash-refused, 3 stop-refused, 4 no_data. Sized notional is a median of 73% of equity (max 90% = the 0.9x buying-power cap, which binds on 118/139). Worst risk 1.46x the per-trade budget, via round-up. FINDING: tqqq_trend_long_1d:TQQQ is UNREACHABLE right now: one share's 2.5xATR14(1d) stop is about 2.8x the per-trade budget (above the 1.5x round-up limit), so the sizer refuses every signal until TQQQ ATR falls. WHAT-IF per-position cap: 50% of equity loses 38/139 pairs and trims 79; 75% loses 11; 90% loses 0. TIER-3 PROPOSAL (awaiting AM/operator): add alpaca_live.risk.max_gross_exposure_pct: 1.0. It uses the existing exposure.py mechanism, is a no-op on today's 1x cash book, and bounds the book if the venue later grants margin; it clears BL-20260823. No per-position cap below the cash cap at this size (it would filter the pooled population by price, a filter not fixed before the run). In the same PR, replace the accounts.yaml 'reachable : TLT IEF SLV USO IAUM GDX' prose with a pointer to the script (clears BL-20260910). Losing-streak: propose floor = min(500, 5% of account equity) for real_money accounts; it can only ADD alerts (option a). Needs the operator's pick (Tier 3).
